mentions.name: Ashdomes
mentions.description: A slow realtime strategy game in the style of Neptune's Pride and Subterfuge, with hourly game ticks and matches that last over a week. Currently in closed alpha.
mentions.problem: The author wished there were more titles in the slow realtime strategy genre popularized by Neptune's Pride and Subterfuge.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A slow, realtime strategy game similar to Neptunes Pride and Subterfuge.

Each game tick is an hour and games can last over a week. I got hooked on both Subterfuge and Neptunes Pride and always wished there were some more titles in this genre.
mentions.author: yhersk0vitz
